title: Answer key preserves a one-year shift in projected interest expense
evidence: The task requests a thorough audit, explicitly including formula inconsistencies and calculation errors, but the golden workbook retains incorrect fiscal-year links. 'Income Statement'!J26 (2021) references 'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73, producing -108.243085614738, although the same-year debt schedules total 163.366216246932 in D73. N26 (2025) references empty I73 and returns zero despite 90.6177177717491 of 2025 interest in H73; this also causes 'Line Item Metrics'!M29 to return #DIV/0!. These defects exist in both the seed and answer key. Correcting only these year mappings in an otherwise golden fixture produces 59 grading mismatches and a modification ratio of 0.6241. Because the sole verifier has weight 1 and requires every modification check to pass, this valid audit correction receives zero credit.
confirmation: GT 'Income Statement'!J26 (2021) is "=-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73" = -108.24 (the 2022 interest), while D73 holds the 2021 163.37. N26 points to empty I73 = 0, causing 'Line Item Metrics'!M29 #DIV/0!. In run <id>, the trial that corrected J26 to -163.37 was flagged 'Modification error at Income State
fix: Same answer-key correction as F4: Income Statement J26:N26 = -'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73:H73 (2021-2025 interest), so N26 is no longer 0 and Line Item Metrics M29 is no longer #DIV/0!.

title: The prompt asks for a thorough audit, but the grader only accepts the two injected AVERAGE fixes, and the answer key leaves other real errors in graded cells unfixed
evidence: problem.py asks the agent to 'audit and fix this file thoroughly' and lists formula logic errors, hardcodes, broken references, data validation, formatting/naming and best-practice issues. The verifier (verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells, weight 1, mode=values, pass/fail) needs every modification cell to match gt_04_golden.xlsx and ≥99.8% of the unchanged ('regression') cells to stay the same. The answer key changes only two graded things: Balance Sheet D67:I67 (DIO window) and LBO Analysis E41:I41 (Senior Notes interest average). It leaves clear errors inside the graded range 'Line Item Metrics'!A2:I35 untouched. H24 (2020 ROA) = H14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:J27), which averages three years (2019–2021). I24 (2021) = I14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!J27:K27), which skips 2020. In row 27 (Debt/Net worth), C27 points to Balance Sheet C, which is 2014, while the column header is 2015, and H→J skips a year. It also leaves unfixed formulas that break the pattern of their row and feed projections: Income Statement J45 AVERAGE($D45:$I45) vs K45 AVERAGE($D45:$H45), and Balance Sheet J70 vs K70. If an agent does the thorough fix it was asked for, graded values change and count as regression errors. The tolerance is only about 11 of about 5,500 graded cells, and an upstream fix that cascades through the three statements fails the whole task. Formatting, naming and data-validation fixes are never graded in values mode.
confirmation: Confirmed in gt_04_golden.xlsx: inside the graded 'Line Item Metrics'!A2:I35, H24=H14/AVERAGE(BS H27:J27) and row 27 C:H point to BS C:H (2014-2019) under 2015-2020 headers. The 'audit thoroughly' prompt invites these fixes, and the all-or-nothing verifier then fails them.
fix: Same answer-key correction as F4: H24/I24 ROA windows, row 27 column offsets, Income Statement J45:N49 and Balance Sheet J70:N74 averages now consistent.

title: Golden working-capital schedule mixes current-year receivables with prior-year balances
evidence: In both the seed and golden workbook, 'PP&E, Debt, NWC' row 80 references same-year accounts receivable, while rows 81–83 reference the preceding year's inventory, payables and accrued expenses. Consequently, golden H84 reports 2020 operating working capital of 22.973, whereas the same-year balance-sheet components yield 14.510 + 187.441 - 99.504 - 57.816 = 44.631. Golden I84 reports 2021 working capital of 45.28395 instead of 22.9805310448202. This makes DCF!C19 report a 22.31095 increase rather than a 21.6504689551798 decrease. The answer key therefore preserves an internally contradictory schedule that the requested thorough audit should repair. Correcting only these period mappings in a golden-fixture copy yields 165 grading mismatches, regression 0.9857 and modification 0.3759, failing the entire weight-1 verifier.
confirmation: In both input and GT, 'PP&E, Debt, NWC' row 80 references same-year AR (C80='Balance Sheet'!D15, 2015), while rows 81-83 reference the prior year (C81='Balance Sheet'!C17, 2014). fix: Same answer-key correction as F4: 'PP&E, Debt, NWC' C81:M83 read the same-year Balance Sheet columns; DCF!C19 is now -21.65 (was 22.31).

title: Ground-truth workbook gt_04_golden.xlsx leaves multiple genuine formula and AVERAGE errors unfixed inside graded ranges, penalizing thorough fixes
evidence:
The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight: 1) requires 100% match on all 141 modification cells (`mod_ratio == 1.0`) and >=99.8% match on regression cells (`reg_ratio >= 0.998`) against `gt_04_golden.xlsx`. While the prompt instructs the agent to 'audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references...', `gt_04_golden.xlsx` differs from `untouched_input_Incorrect Average_input.xlsx` in only 12 formula cells (`Balance Sheet!D67:I67`, `Line Item Metrics!L24`, and `LBO Analysis!E41:I41`) and retains numerous genuine formula bugs inside the graded `answer_position` ranges:
1. Broken `AVERAGE` formulas in `Line Item Metrics!H24:M24` (Return on assets): `C24:G24` (2015-2019) compute Net Income divided by 2-year average Total Assets (`AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!C27:D27)` through `G27:H27`). In `gt_04_golden.xlsx`, `H24` (2020, inside graded `'Line Item Metrics'!A2:I35`) uses a 3-year average `=H14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:J27)` (0.024291 vs. correct `H27:I27` = 0.028963), and `I24` (2021, a graded modification cell) averages 2021-2022 assets `=I14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!J27:K27)` (0.021317 vs. correct 2020-2021 `I27:J27` = 0.023649, a 10.9% difference that fails the 1% tolerance). Even worse, in `Line Item Metrics!L24` (2024 ROA), the input file actually had the correct 2023-2024 range `=L14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!L27:M27)` and `gt_04_golden.xlsx` changed it to the wrong 2024-2025 range `=L14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!M27:N27)`.
2. Off-by-one broken cell references in `Income Statement!J26:N26` (Projected Interest Expense): On `PP&E, Debt, NWC`, `D73:H73` (`Total Interest Expense`) sums Period 1-5 (2021-2025) interest (`D61+L61 = 163.366` in 2021 through `H61+P61 = 90.618` in 2025), while `I73` is blank (0). In `gt_04_golden.xlsx`, `Income Statement!J26:N26` (2021-2025) references `=-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73:I73` instead of `D73:H73`, shifting 2022-2025 interest into 2021-2024 and setting 2025 interest (`N26`) to 0. When Unit 3 fixed `Income Statement!J26:N26` to reference `D73:H73`, the verifier failed it (`Modification error at Income Statement!J26: answer=-108.243085614738, output=-163.366216246933`).
3. Inconsistent `AVERAGE` ranges in `Income Statement!K45:N49` and `Balance Sheet!K70:N74`: Column J (2021) averages 2015-2020 (`=AVERAGE($D:$I)`), whereas columns K:N (2022-2025) omit 2020 (`=AVERAGE($D:$H)`) and `Balance Sheet!J71:N71` uses an unanchored `=AVERAGE(D71:I71)`..`=AVERAGE(H71:M71)`. Fixing `Balance Sheet!K70:N74` changes projected working capital, `DCF!C32`, and `Summary!H13`.
4. Off-by-one column shifts in `PP&E, Debt, NWC!C81:M83` (OWC Inventory, AP, and Accrued Expenses for 2015-2025 pull 2014-2024 Balance Sheet columns `C:M` while AR in `C80:M80` pulls 2015-2025 columns `D:N`) and `Line Item Metrics!C27:H27` and `H35:M35` (which skip 2020 column I on the Balance Sheet).
confirmation: GT differs from the input in only 12 formulas (BS D67:I67, LIM L24, LBO E41:I41). It keeps real errors in graded ranges: 'Line Item Metrics'!H24 averages BS H27:J27 (3 years), and I24 uses J27:K27 (2021-22 for 2021). In run <id>, the trial that fixed Income Statement!J26 dropped to modification
fix: gt_04_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named (93 formula cells, all cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc): Line Item Metrics H24:M24 ROA averages the prior and current year's total assets (H24 =H14/AVERAGE('Balance Sheet'!H27:I27), I24 I27:J27, ... M24 M27:N27); Line Item Metrics C27:H27 debt/net worth now read the same year's Balance Sheet column (D:I instead of C:H); Line Item Metrics H35:M35 net PP&E now read Balance Sheet I:N instead of J:O; Income Statement J26:N26 interest now links to the same year, =-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73 ... H73 (was E73 ... blank I73); Income Statement K45:N49 and Balance Sheet K70:N70, K72:N72, K74:N74 now average all six historical years : like column J (were :), and Balance Sheet J71:N71 =AVERAGE(:) (was a rolling window that pulled in projections); 'PP&E, Debt, NWC' C81:M83 inventory, payables and accrued expenses now read the same year as receivables (Balance Sheet D:N instead of C:M).
